ms.promise: Prepare brochure and bulletin boards. Exhibit a booth at BlockchainEXPO 2023 Autum (25-27 Oct.）in Tokyo.
ms.criteria: Having an actual booth exhibit and Distribute more than 1,500 brochures and acquired more than 350 contacts. Attract 350+ new participants to sns and sub-events.
ms.report:
[Response to Review #1】
We will add an additional exhibit of the same size as this one that was implemented at half price.
If ADA prices increase, we will first return the booth size to normal. If there is room for more, we have several ideas. ⓵There are measures to make the exhibition more efficient, such as automating roster registration and introducing incentives and management systems to measure member activity and increase efficiency. ⓵Exhibitions will be held in cities other than Tokyo. Research on exhibition methods is underway.
Interested companies have been listed in the Cardano FORUM. https://forum.cardano.org/t/expo-2023-10-25-27-exibited-in-blockchein-expo-2023-fall-japan/123369 (sorry I forgot to attach it) Many crypto asset trading, newspaper companies, publishers, banks, HONDA, NISSANN, FUJIFILM, etc.

[Response to review #2】
Yes, as I answered in #1, we will use it for other exhibitions. 2024/Feb or 2024/May are the current options, but we are still investigating costs, etc.
This invoice is for the entry, which was originally requested to be paid in September before our project was accepted by Catalyst, but we asked them to wait as long as possible. The change to legal tender was made on October 23. Not paying until after the event in anticipation of an uptrend would be a violation of Cardano's credibility.
I have added Japanese and English versions of the flyer at the end of the report in the Cardano forum of the link above.
Regards.

ms.promise: Prepare brochure and bulletin boards. Exhibit a booth at BlockchainEXPO 2024 Spring (22-24 May）in Tokyo.
ms.criteria: Having an actual booth exhibit and distributed more than 2500 brochures and obtained more than 350 contacts. Attract 350+ new participants to sns and sub-events.
ms.report:
We will respond to the two points raised. We were able to recover in subsequent exhibitions.　Please refer to the link for data. Thank you.　https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1AN-iiPgsq-jWJmr8BH5ZcO4D-p4xw87o/edit?usp=sharing&ouid=108376072923887342147&rtpof=true&sd=true
1【Point raised】The actual number of pamphlets distributed did not reach the target of 2,500.
【Countermeasures】We made up for it at the next EXPO Autumn. We increased the number of exhibition projects and the number of members working on them, and also approached other booths at the venue.
【Result】 We made up for the shortfall from the previous Spring EXPO and reached the target of 6,000 for the project as a whole.
2.【Point】 The method for grasping the incremental increase in community participants was inadequate.
【Countermeasure】 We created a new account dedicated to the exhibition booth. The target for measuring the increase in member followers was limited to the account for the exhibition booth and the accounts of the members in the booth.
【Result】The increase in followers of the exhibition booth and the members who worked at the booth made up for the shortfall from the previous Spring EXPO, and we were also able to reach the overall project target of 1000.
